newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY-GRIQUAS SWAMP NORTHERN FREE STATE 78-10.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY-GRIQUAS SWAMP NORTHERN FREE STATE 78-10.

text.p: Griqualand West swept aside Northern Free State 78-10 (halftime 31-10) in their Currie Cup rugby match at Hoffe Park on Friday night.
Although trailing 7-10 after the first quarter, the home side then asserted their all-round dominance and ran in 12 tries to post their sixth win of the season in the competition.

Halfbacks Abrie Pretorius and Franco Smith, who both went over for a try, were the outstanding performers in an impressive display by Griquas who have now ousted Western Province from third place on the section B table.
Although both sides have 12 points from nine games, Griquas have the better points difference.

Flyhalf Smith scored 23 points through his second half try and nine conversions while wings Ian Horn and Leon van der Wath, fullback Edrich Lubbe and flanker Theo Oosthuizen all collected two tries apiece as the floodgates opened.
Griqualand West - Tries: Abrie Pretorius, Andre Cloete, Leon van der Wath (2), Ian Horn (2), Theo Oosthuizen (2), Edrich Lubbe (2), Franco Smith, Dawie Theron. Conversions: Franco Smith (9).
Northern Free State - Try: Willie Nagel. Conversion: Eric Herbert. Penalty: Herbert.
